subject: Post-call: data sandboxing & minimal PII sharing checks
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Apr 2028 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: data sandboxing & minimal PII sharing checks

Thanks again for the call this morning — good to meet the FinLedger team. Quick recap + items we agreed to follow up on related to data handling and partners:

• What you consider PII in event payloads (examples we can test against).
• Retention windows for raw logs vs analytics aggregates.
• Which third parties receive telemetry (names + roles).
• Marketplace flow: do marketplace partners ever append raw user identifiers to event webhooks?

Attached is a short security one-pager for context (redwood_security_onepager.pdf). Our immediate asks so we can scope a minimal proof-of-concept sandbox:

1) Example event payload (redacted) showing the user_id or other identifier you record.
2) List of telemetry vendors + whether they receive tokenized vs raw IDs.
3) Any residency requirement for the subset of data you'd send to Redwood (US-only for now? some EU customers?).

Proposed next steps: you can reply to this thread with the items above, or drop the example payloads into the Drive link I shared on the call. If easier, we can schedule a 30-min follow-up this week to go over specifics and a vendor contact.

Thanks — Jonas

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finledger.com>

Cc: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@finledger.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Apr 2028 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: data sandboxing & minimal PII sharing checks

Thanks Jonas — great overview and appreciate the one-pager. Quick answers inline:

• PII in payloads: primary identifier is user_id (UUID). We also send email_address to auth systems but it is not present in analytics event streams. Public event schema attached separately.
• Retention: raw ingestion logs are retained for 90 days for billing/debug; aggregated analytics retained for 3 years. We are comfortable with a short-term proof-of-concept that retains only aggregated outputs.
• Telemetry vendors: we currently forward to InsightsCo (telemetry@insights.co) for product analytics and to CloudLog (cloudlog@vendor.com) for long-term retention. InsightsCo receives hashed user_id (SHA256 token) in the analytics pipe; CloudLog receives raw logs for audit/billing — this is the one we are most concerned about minimizing for POC.
• Marketplace flow: marketplace partners POST webhook events to our ingestion endpoint. Those webhooks include a marketplace_user_id tokenized by the marketplace; no direct raw email addresses are sent by partners.

I attached the product event schema (redacted) and can introduce you to our InsightsCo contact if helpful.

Priya
Priya Shah

On Mon, Apr 9, 2028 at 2:23 PM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the call this morning — good to meet the FinLedger team. Quick recap + items we agreed to follow up on related to data handling and partners:
> ...

Brief privacy/checklist items for the POC based on Priya's reply:

1) Confirm that InsightsCo receives only hashed user_id (obtain vendor contract or data processing addendum that specifies hashing).
2) For CloudLog (raw logs): we need to limit scope for POC. Ask FinLedger if CloudLog can be excluded from the POC ingest path or if they can provide a filtered export (billing-only fields).
3) Retention: POC should default to aggregated outputs only and auto-delete raw PII-derived KV caches after 7 days. We should propose a minimal retention policy for the sandbox and note deviations for production.
4) Marketplace webhooks: get a sample webhook payload and confirm the marketplace's tokenization mechanism (HMAC vs opaque token).
5) Evidence: request SOC2 AOC or a recent security attestation from FinLedger and vendor point-of-contact for InsightsCo.

I'll draft the vendor questionnaire (fields + required artifacts) and the short PII minimization controls we want implemented in the sandbox. Looping Monica for scope/ops notes.

Marissa Cole
Privacy & Compliance, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
